Hostile Atmosphere.text: At the start of the environment turn, the environment deals each Hero Target 1 Toxic Damage.
Hostile Atmosphere.start of turn: Deal each Hero Target 1 Toxic Damage.

Cosmic Inversion Eradicator.text: At the end of the environment turn, this card deals each Hero 2 Energy Damage.
Cosmic Inversion Eradicator.on destroy: Each Hero may draw a card.

Decompression.text: The environment deals 1 Hero Target 4 Cold Damage.

Failing Life Support.text: Reduce HP regained by Hero Targets by 1.

Asteroid Strike.text: Destroy 1 Ongoing or Equipment card. The environment deals each Target 1 Sonic Damage.

Martian Dust Storm.text: At the start of the environment turn, each Hero Target regains 1 fewer HP.

Radiation Leak.text: The environment deals 1 Hero Target 2 Toxic Damage.

Sealed Airlock.text: Each Hero may play a card. Then destroy 1 Ongoing card.
